steps.title: Dissect Medulla Oblongata
steps.instruction: Dissect the dorsal medulla oblongata from paraformaldehyde-fixed coronal sections of the medulla oblongata.

steps.title: Extract and Measure Total RNA
steps.instruction: Extract total RNA using the Nucleic Acid Isolation Kit (Ambion) and measure the yield using a nanodrop.

steps.title: Extract Reference RNA
steps.instruction: If necessary, extract RNA from human brain (Agilent Technologies) to serve as a reference sample.

steps.title: Synthesize cDNA
steps.instruction: Synthesize cDNA using SuperScriptVILO Master Mix (Life Technologies) and suitable primers with a 20 µL final volume.

steps.title: Prepare qPCR Reaction Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare a 20 µL reaction mix containing cDNA, Power SYBRGreen (Applied Biosystems), and primers.

steps.title: Perform Real-Time PCR
steps.instruction: Run the PCR in triplicates using a real-time PCR machine (e.g., StepOnePlusTM real-time PCR system, Applied Biosystems).

steps.title: Analyze PCR Products via Gel Electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Load PCR products onto a 2.0% SeaKem agarose gel (Lonza Bioscience) pre-stained with RedSafe dye (1:20,000, Intron Biotechnology).

substeps.instruction: Mix PCR products with 6x sample buffer (New England Biolabs) and 5% DMSO
